questions.prompt: A binomial variable has \(n=100\) and \(p=0.02\). Use a Poisson approximation to estimate \(P(X=1)\).
questions.answer: For rare events with large \(n\) and small \(p\), use \(\lambda=np=2\). Then \[P(X=1)\approx e^{-2}2^{1}/1!=0.27067.\]
